findings: n2_parity: with FULLPOL hold_lane_pin ON (c4/fullpol-5a 5cbd616e fullpol_ev.hold_pins) the policy N2 hold execution (lane_drop e36ece92 member_command / SoloHold) issues IDENTICAL TraCI writes (speed + lane) to the plant path for solo0/1/2, wall_h, l2hold_l1gap, solo2 v15/v18/v22, solo2_lanes and the gated solo2 twins. With the pin OFF, speed writes are identical but the plant path additionally pins laneChangeMode 513. The S-REGIMEU0 solo2 EV was measured WITH the pin. Onsets > 30 s (l2hold_stagger) and mixed-parameter groups of > 3 roles cannot be represented in N2.
S-WMSEARCH (wmsearch_u0) results convert to the FULLPOL schema, but their lane programs ran on the frozen G5 path (closing-lane entries refused): this is NOT verification by the policy executor.
